acceptanceCriteria: caller_deadline waits on the caller context's Done channel, with no fixed sleep; the test passes 200x under -count=200 -race locally
If the bridge classification changes, MCPV0-038 wording and decision 0533 references are updated in the same change; otherwise the build log states the product code was unchanged
Nightly release-gates passes on main and issue #1116 is closed after a scheduled run passes (release owner)
body: GitHub issue #1116 (nightly release-gates on main at 0fce98369, run 39121848489, macos-15 full-gate). The only failure is internal/mcp/bridge/git_timeout_test.go:100: index refusal = repository-probe-timeout, want cancelled. The caller_deadline case creates context.WithTimeout(50ms), then sleeps 60ms inside build, and expects the bridge to see the ended caller context. A timerCtx's Err() is set only when its timer callback runs, and on a loaded runner that callback can lag past the sleep, so the bridge sees a live context and classifies the index deadline as repository-probe-timeout. Expected: deterministic. Fix the test to wait on <-ctx.Done() (passing ctx into end) instead of sleeping. Also check whether the bridge classification should treat a passed ctx.Deadline() as ended (product behavior per MCPV0-038 / decision 0533); change it only if the spec says so.
title: Nightly full-gate red: TestMCPV0038IndexDeadlineHasDistinctCode/caller_deadline races the context timer (#1116)
